items.title: Body Narrative

items.body: Filtered samples retain 93.6% capacity at the final checkpoint versus 89.2% in the untreated reference. The third formulation reaches 92.1%. These samples support a limited pilot, but differences in initial conditioning and unresolved moisture results prevent a causal attribution to filtration alone.

items.title: Body Narrative

items.detail: Stop release if moisture exceeds 20 ppm or copper exceeds 0.10 ppm. The assay repeat is pending; improved retention alone does not authorize shipment.
items.statement: Release 20 pilot cells after duplicate assays pass
items.title: Risk Callout

items.body: Decision: release 20 pilot cells only after the moisture repeat and trace-metal duplicate pass. Keep the untreated reference running through 200 cycles and review thermal behavior before expanding.
